_comment: POWERED-UP trainable dataset on real Pegasus connectivity. The 96-parent version gave 12 test parents, and at that size the embedding-aware-versus-blind contrast is -0.00835 [-0.02019, +0.00106]: the same point estimate as the synthetic campaign's -0.00782 but a 3.2x wider interval that crosses zero. An effect this size at this variance needs about 19 parents. 240 parents gives roughly 30 in test, past that threshold, so the contrast can either separate or fail to separate for a reason other than sample size. Everything else is unchanged from data_pegasus_trainable.json so the two are directly comparable. Still no spectral teacher above 10 qubits, so neither the privileged-oracle comparison nor the physics-auxiliary ablation runs here.
